doc_title_en: Notice on Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ended March 2027
doc_title_jp: 通期業績予想（連結）の修正並びに配当予想の修正(増配)に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期連結業績予想の修正に鑑み…当社は…DOE5％以上、配当性向50％以上、且つ累進配当の実現を目標

summary_en: FY2027 guidance (ended Mar 2027): annual dividend raised to 82 yen/share (41 + 41 mid-term + year-end) from prior 80 yen, reflecting upward net profit revision from 9.0 to 9.5 billion yen. Policy target: DOE 5%+ and payout ratio 50%+ with progressive dividends.
summary_jp: FY2027予想年間配当を82円/株(41+41)に修正、従前80円から上方修正。純利益見通し9.0→9.5B円の引き上げに伴う。政策目標：DOE5%以上・配当性向50%以上の累進配当。
tag_en: Dividend Hike – 82 yen/share (41 + 41) vs 80 yen prior guidance – progressive policy targeting DOE 5%+, payout ratio 50%+
tag_jp: 配当予想の修正(増配) – 82円/株(41円+41円) 対 80円従前予想 – DOE5%以上・配当性向50%以上・累進配当政策
